0022600097.text: The Toronto Raptors visit the Washington Wizards for the Raptors' second game of the 2026-27 season, with both teams unbeaten at 1-0. Toronto is second in the Atlantic and fourth in the East, while Washington is second in the Southeast and fifth in the East. Toronto is missing Brandon Ingram (Achilles, surgery) and Nate Bittle (foot), and Washington is without AJ Dybantsa (ankle, sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip), with Felix Okpara listed as day-to-day with an illness and a game-time decision. The Raptors won the last meeting 134-125 in Washington on February 28, 2026, and the season series in 2025-26 went Raptors 2-1, while no games between the teams have been played yet this season.
